listing.name: THE MOD THAT INCONSISTANTLY CRASHES YOUR GAME
listing.summary: Ever want to experience what it's like to play in an unstable modding scene, but all the modern mods are too dang stable? Well, with the low low price of 0.00$, you too can experience what its like to play an unstable modlist with INCONSISTENT CRASHES, based on certain actions you may take! Guaranteed frustration, keyboard smashes, and HOURS of progress lost! NO WARRANTIES.
listing.aiSummary: Causes the game to crash inconsistently based on certain player actions.

description: Simulates an unstable modding environment by triggering random crashes during gameplay. These crashes are intended behavior rather than bugs, though consistent crashing indicates a broken installation.
